Entity Description: An instrumented authentication operation ended without success. Use provider and auth_operation; do not infer the person's reason.
An instrumented Apple, Google, or email authentication operation began. Use provider and auth_operation; anonymous launch is not counted as a login here.
An instrumented authentication operation completed successfully. Can mean account linking or account creation, not just sign-in.
The current account was signed out before analytics identity was reset. A subsequent guest identity is a separate state.
The app initialized its analytics service during launch. A launch is not a new install or a login.
The installation recorded its first launch using local defaults. Can repeat after reinstall or on another device; not first-ever customer.
The active session ended; duration_ms measures foreground session time. Process termination may prevent delivery; not total lifetime usage.
The app entered an active foreground session. Repeated active notifications are deduplicated until the session ends.
The client's full-book kickoff task was cancelled. Can result from replacement or task cancellation, not necessarily a deliberate user cancel.
The client finished or restored the book-ready finalization state. May repeat on resume; count unique people, not unique books, without a stable job identifier.
The client observed full-book failure at kickoff, cloud job, or finalization. Use failure_stage; repeated snapshots may repeat observations.
The client requested a full-book generation run with a target page count. Not authoritative backend acceptance; page_count is requested target here.
The client observed the cloud illustration-completion milestone. Client finalization still remains; memory_count is completed illustrated memories.
The regular capture flow failed at authentication, audio-file validation, or local persistence. Use failure_stage to identify the failing part.
A chapter prompt was opened for a recording or prompt-choice flow. Use chapter_number and is_completed; no prompt text is sent.
The regular recording flow successfully saved a memory locally. save_scope=local; not a cloud-sync guarantee or all capture routes.
The regular memory recorder successfully began audio capture. Separate from onboarding recording; no audio is sent to analytics.

Extracted character details were successfully encoded and saved to the local memory store. Local persistence only; cloud synchronization is queued afterward. Historical builds before this fix could report attempted saves as success.
The guided memory-enhancement screen appeared. voice_available indicates whether voice interaction is available.
Guided extraction completed and produced character details. characters_extracted counts people/characters, not letters; not a save guarantee.
A memory audio player reported playback completion. Use playback_source to distinguish local and remote.
Memory audio playback encountered an error. No private audio or raw error message is sent.
Remote memory playback was requested. Request only; does not prove audio actually began.
Local memory playback started. Current started instrumentation is local; remote playback has a separate request event.
A saved memory detail view appeared. Can repeat on revisits; not proof the memory was fully read.
The system share callback ended without completion or error. Not proof of dissatisfaction.
Share preparation or the system share callback reported an error. Use failure_stage when present.
The prepared memory share sheet was presented. Not a completed share.
The system share callback reported a completed activity. Not proof of delivery or recipient readership.
A tracked field edit ended with character_count and duration_ms. Count and duration only; no field contents. Abandoned edits may lack completion.
The first edit began for a named field in the current input session. No typed text or individual keystrokes are collected.
A named screen was explicitly reported as viewed. Generic helper; use screen to identify destination.
The selected home or saved-memories tab changed. Not every tab appearance or initial app landing.
An audited named control action was explicitly reported. Use action and screen; does not capture every tap automatically.
A narrator photo was accepted from the camera or photo library. Only source is tracked; no photo or photo URL is sent.
Onboarding could not establish the authenticated session required for preparation. Currently failure_stage=auth; not every possible preparation failure is instrumented.
The onboarding recorder reported a recording error. Use failure_stage; raw error text is not sent.
The onboarding recorder changed to recording. Different from tapping the record button; recording_duration is seconds.
The onboarding recorder stopped recording. Not confirmation of transcription, saving, or upload.
A client attempt to generate the personalized preview began. Use generation_attempt; not authoritative backend admission.
The onboarding memory was saved locally before cloud generation. Local persistence does not prove cloud sync or generation success.
The onboarding memory synchronization step completed. Does not mean the generated illustration is ready.
The person navigated to the personalized reveal with image and audio readiness satisfied. Primary activation milestone; not proof the entire page was read or audio heard.
The client preview-generation attempt ended with an error. Use failure_kind when allowed; no private error message is sent.
The client received the personalized preview image result. duration_ms is client elapsed time; separate cached from fresh results.
A named onboarding control was tapped. Use action and screen to distinguish continue, back, skip, reveal, and recording controls.
The person selected who the memoir is for. audience is a bounded choice, never a name.
The onboarding flow moved to the background. Not proof of churn; the person may return.
Onboarding marked itself complete after the paywall was dismissed. Not a subscription purchase or payment.
The onboarding flow returned to the foreground. Pair with background events for interruption analysis.
Authenticated onboarding preparation reached its start milestone. May repeat in debug replay; flow_id is view-instance scoped.
The flow left a step and measured step_duration_ms. This is a navigation exit, not guaranteed app abandonment tracking.
The onboarding flow displayed a step. Use screen and step; repeated visits are expected.
The sample-book tour finished and the flow advanced. Does not mean a personalized page was generated or onboarding completed.
Alex's sample audio player changed to playing. Demo playback is not the customer's own memory or personalized activation.
Alex's sample audio player stopped playing. Includes stopping or reaching the end; not a dedicated completion event.
The onboarding paywall sheet appeared. Context event; use Paywall Viewed for the main impression denominator, do not sum both.
The paywall presentation was dismissed. Use dismissal_reason; closing is not necessarily purchase cancellation.
The app could not prepare the subscription paywall. This may prevent a Paywall Viewed impression.
The prepared subscription paywall appeared once for a presentation_id. Exposure does not mean purchase intent or payment.
The app could not activate or verify the expected entitlement. Not necessarily a failed App Store charge; inspect purchase_origin and failure_stage.
The app began applying or verifying an entitlement after purchase or restore. Use purchase_origin to separate purchase and restore.
The app confirmed a usable subscription entitlement. Can include a trial or restored entitlement; use RevenueCat lifecycle events for paid revenue.
The purchase flow reported user cancellation. Not a refund or subscription expiration.
The purchase flow reported an error. Not a confirmed charge; use failure_stage.
The paywall purchase flow started. Not a confirmed charge or entitlement.
The restore flow reported an error. Does not prove the customer has no existing entitlement.
The person started restoring purchases. Not a new purchase.

Guided enhancement could not encode or locally persist the extracted character details. No successful-save event is sent for this attempt. Final saves offer retry; partial saves report an error and remain eligible for another attempt.
The app could not persist the local state needed to queue a transcription retry. failure_stage=local_save; no backend transcription completion is implied.
A requested transcription retry was saved locally with queued status before cloud synchronization was scheduled. Not backend acceptance or successful transcription. save_scope=local.

Regular memory recording could not start because authentication was unavailable, recorder creation failed, or the recorder refused to begin. Use bounded diagnostic_reason. This does not include every permission refusal or recording failure; no raw error message or file path is sent.

A foreground-active timing segment ended for the topmost instrumented screen. duration_ms excludes inactive/background time and covered instrumented screens. Sum segments for dwell; event count is not visits. A crash or force quit can lose the final segment. System pickers and other uninstrumented overlays can still count toward the parent.
